headline: TCB Shares Hit Ceiling Price After Report of Billion-Dollar Deal
summary: Techcombank may sell a 15% stake to a foreign strategic investor in a deal valued at up to $2 billion. Its shares rose the maximum daily limit of 6.87% to 33,450 dong.
why: Techcombank is a large Vietnamese commercial bank, and stake sales to strategic investors can signal changes in ownership and capital. Its share price is a widely followed gauge of Vietnamese banking sentiment.
why_moved: A report that Techcombank may sell a 15% stake to a foreign strategic investor, valued at up to $2 billion, put the shares in focus. The stock closed at its daily ceiling in the 26 August session.
